newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Turnover, prices higher on the Bucharest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Turnover, prices higher on the Bucharest bourse.

text.p: Turnover and most prices on the Bucharest stock exchange went up on Thursday as buying pressure had started to mount, traders said.

Turnover drifted higher to 2.0 billion lei from 1.7 billion previously, with the two stocks listed on the first tier -- Oltchim SA chemical plant and fertiliser maker Azomures SA -- taking 94 percent of turnover.
"Local investors seem to sense a depreciation of the leu in the not too distant future and they are now rushing to do something with leu funds," a trader said.
The leu is now firmer at around 7,000 to the dollar after tough monetary policies. The appreciation follows a slump which sent it spiralling to 9,000 from 4,000 in the New Year.
High-cap Oltchim had some 1.4 billion lei in turnover and closed 100 lei stronger at 1,400. The other first-tier stock Azomures ended 50 lei higher at 1,360.
"As usual, the two had the bulk of trading, but today there was some action also on the second tier," said another trader.
Carbid-Fox SA carbide maker, drilling company Foraj Sonde SA and Policolor dye maker were the most active on the second tier, seeing their prices rise.
Two unofficial indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- rose from the previous session by 5.4 and respectively 5.49 percent.
The BIG for the first tier went up by 23.45 percent on the previous session to 1,554.1 points. Its base is 1,000 points.
